items.title: Johnson & Johnson wins FDA approval for Rybrevant cancer treatment
items.summary: Investing.com-- Johnson & Johnson received accelerated approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration on Thursday for RYBREVANT FASPRO as a single-agent treatment for adults with recurrent or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.

items.title: Pfizer (PFE) Stock Looks Attractive for Income Investors
items.summary: Pfizer (PFE) stock looks attractive for income investors because of its well-covered dividend and modest valuation. The drug maker’s shares have outperformed the S&P 500 (SPX) in 2026, mirroring the strong performance of the healthcare sector as tracked by the iShares U.S. Healthcare ETF (IYH). items.title: Genmab nine-month revenue rises 22% as late-stage pipeline delivers
items.summary: Investing.com -- Genmab reported a 22% rise in revenue for the first nine months of 2026 on Thursday, driven by higher royalties from Darzalex and Kesimpta and stronger sales of its cancer drug Epkinly. The Danish biotech maintained its full-year guidance.
